received_works.body:
Hello sensei,

My friend recommended your work to me and I would love to request a costume design for my OC Jade. 

She was born with an incurable heart disease but despite her frail health, she has a cold and bitter personality that rejects the helping hand of others. Because of complications, she doesn't like to talk about her past and prefers to keep to herself. She is a magician and specializes in potion making.

She has an elegant and refined aura to her but doesn't dress herself too gaudily. She gets cold due to bad blood circulation so a coat would be lovely! Something that is mysterious, femme, and dark would suit her well. Her hair is very wavy but doesn't look too disheveled and she has a mole on her cheek. Her hair is black and her eyes are dark green.

Themes: solitude, alchemist, fleeting, white flowers, death/funeral, gothic

If it's okay with you I'd like to use the design, with credit, when I draw my own art for commercial purposes. Thank you for your consideration!

https://sta.sh/0ew0m7359o4
